answer: Crystal-Anchored Resume Nonces. Each new identity must submit a nonce derived from fresh hardware entropy; the registry anchors it in a crystal lattice commitment stored per epoch. Enforcement: an identity is admitted only if its nonce differs from every active nonce by a minimum entropy distance, so duplicate or cloned agents are rejected outright. An attacker must source distinct physical randomness per clone, like dredging a unique marble from an ocean of identical ones, paying hardware and entropy-harvesting cost that exceeds any clone's expected yield.
